orders.title: Light the Fire Bowl
orders.blurb: Bring me 6 Gem Chips, Keeper. The Fire Bowl has been cold for sixty years. Light it, and I will show you my surprise.

orders.title: Warm the Fireplace
orders.blurb: Merge 3 Gem Chips to make a Fire Gem. Bring me 2 Fire Gems and the big hall will be warm tonight.

orders.title: Make Moonwater
orders.blurb: 3 Dew Drops make a Dew Bottle. 3 Dew Bottles make Moonwater. Bring me 1 Moonwater — I need it for my magic.

orders.title: Make a Sun Gem
orders.blurb: Merge 3 Fire Gems to make a Sun Gem. Bring me 1 Sun Gem. It will light up the whole hall.

orders.title: A Gift for Eleanor
orders.blurb: Bring me 2 Berry Baskets. I will save them for winter, when nothing grows.

orders.title: Fill the Treasure Room
orders.blurb: One last big order: 3 Sun Gems. That fills my treasure room, and proves Emberkeep is alive again.

orders.title: Make Camp on the Ice
orders.blurb: You came a long way to stand on the ice. Bring me 2 Glass Floats. I will hang them up as lights. Then you may explore the coast.

orders.title: Feed the Northern Dragons
orders.blurb: My dragons eat Tar Loaves, not berries. Nothing grows up here. Bring me 3 Tar Loaves.

orders.title: Search the Shipwrecks
orders.blurb: Every shipwreck brings iron to the beach. Make 2 Iron Helmets at the forge and bring them to me.

orders.title: A Gift for Selyna
orders.blurb: Bring me 2 Glass Floats. Carry them up the beach yourself. I want to see how you work.

orders.title: Weave the Aurora
orders.blurb: Weave 2 Aurora Cloaks and bring them to me. Do that, and I will tell you the secret I have been keeping.

repeatable.title: More Gem Chips
repeatable.blurb: The Fire Bowl is hungry again. Bring me 8 Gem Chips, please.

repeatable.title: More Fire Gems
repeatable.blurb: Bring me 2 Fire Gems for the hallway lamps.

repeatable.title: More Rubies
repeatable.blurb: Bring me 5 Rubies. Your red dragon finds them everywhere.

repeatable.title: Another Sun Gem
repeatable.blurb: One more Sun Gem, please. The Keep can never be too bright.

repeatable.title: More Glass Balls
repeatable.blurb: Bring me 8 Glass Balls from the beach. I need more lights.

repeatable.title: More Tar Loaves
repeatable.blurb: 2 more Tar Loaves. My dragons are hungry again.

repeatable.title: More Light Thread
repeatable.blurb: Bring me 5 Light Threads. I weave in the evenings.

repeatable.title: Another Ember Heart
repeatable.blurb: One more Ember Heart. Keep it away from the cloth — it is hot!
